seeds.name: Arithmetic accumulation loop plus iterative-Fibonacci recursion
seeds.description: A 900,000-iteration modulo-accumulation loop plus 26 calls into a recursive Fibonacci helper; about 110-125 ms.

seeds.name: String concatenation and printf-style formatting
seeds.description: Builds a 60,000-character string by repeated += concatenation, then formats 4,500 lines with fmt.sprintf; about 200-240 ms.

seeds.name: Map churn followed by a hand-rolled insertion sort
seeds.description: Populates and increments a 60-key map across 45,000 insertions, sorts its keys, then insertion-sorts a 1,200-element numeric list (tengo's stdlib has no sort() builtin); about 95-120 ms.

seeds.name: Same arithmetic/recursion workload at much higher volume
seeds.description: A 50,000,000-iteration version of fib-arithmetic's accumulation loop for the macOS sampler; about 4.4-4.7 s.
